entities.name: Ignjat Đurđević
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ignjat Đurđević, also known as Ignazio Giorgi was a Ragusan Baroque poet and translator, best known for his long poem Uzdasi Mandaljene pokornice. He wrote poetry in Latin, Italian, and Croatian.
